text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:
- Representatives of the Swiss office for environment said that a UN conference in New York to discuss the effects of the Rio World Environment Summit would be a milestone.
- Swiss Telecom PTT will merge its international carrier services with Unisource partners starting January 1, 1998.

- A majority of the Swiss parliament favours changing Swiss immigration legislation so that refugees from war and crisis regions may stay in Switzerland, even without previously submitting an application for asylum.
- The Swiss parliament is currently discussing a tax reform. Liberal representatives plan to introduce a new taxation scheme for holding companies.
- The Swiss lower house of parliament decided that the government should give financial support to a bid by the Canton of Wallis for the 2006 Winter Olympic games.

- Philippe Pidoux, member of parliament from the Canton of Vaud, said that he planed to launch initiatives in the cantons of Vaud and Geneva to merge the two cantons in order the build a second super region in Switzerland.
